messages:
Mira: Quick sync — need a compact benchmark narrative for the launch + webinar. Can we settle on 3 chart hooks and 2 headline lines by EOD? 📣
Samir: Yes. Proposed hooks: 1) 'Throughput vs $/1k tokens' sparkline. 2) '99th%-ile tail latency' violin. 3) 'Effective cost after prefix cache' waterfall. Short names: TPS-$, Tail Lat, Cache Saver.
Jordan: Love #3. Can we show real numbers for chat 2k tokens? e.g., baseline hosted vs dedicated vs quantized private. I'll pull numbers from infra.
Priya: Copy ideas: Headline A: 'High performance inference that doesn't break the bank' Headline B: 'Faster responses, lower token bills' Callouts: 'Predictable latency SLA', 'Savings at scale'
Samir: For visuals: use a stacked bar for cost breakdown (compute, memory, cache hit savings). Add small table with assumptions: seq len, model size, qbits. I'll draft.
Mira: Routing: webinar signups -> tiered nurture: demo invites for enterprise, doc + quickstart for self-serve. @Priya can you draft 2 email subject lines?
Priya: Sure: 1) 'See inference that scales — benchmark preview' 2) 'How we cut token costs 3x for chat apps'
Jordan: Dataset note: include sample prompt distribution (avg tokens 120 -> 2.2% tail). Might help justify batching strategy.
Samir: Agree. For launch post: lead with a single chart (TPS-$) + one sentence summary + link to deep benchmark. Keep examples small.
Mira: :thumbsup: timeline: visuals by tomorrow noon, copy by 4pm, final review 6pm. @deploy-bot will post recording to #all-hands after webinar.
deploy-bot: Scheduled: webinar recording upload at 2024-06-25T20:00:00Z. :white_check_mark:
Mira: Thanks team — I'll consolidate into a one-pager and share.
